title: Đêm Bầu Trời Đỏ — Tập Thử Nghiệm MVP
style_prompt_prefix: cinematic dark anime film still, Makoto Shinkai and Ufotable lighting, detailed cel-shaded painterly background, dramatic atmospheric fog, 16:9 widescreen

shots.dialogue: Bầu trời đêm nay đột nhiên đỏ rực một cách kỳ lạ.
shots.image_prompt: medium shot of Minh Khang standing alone on a damp stone lookout balcony at midnight, looking up with alert eyes toward a surreal glowing crimson night sky, red storm clouds illuminating his dark navy hooded trench coat and silver collar clasp, cool blue town lights below
shots.motion_prompt: camera slowly tilts up, wind blowing Minh Khang's messy black hair and trench coat lapels, dramatic crimson clouds churning overhead, subtle breathing and blinking

shots.dialogue: Không ai trong thị trấn biết rằng đó là điềm báo của một kỷ nguyên mới.
shots.image_prompt: wide aerial view of a quiet misty mountain town in Vietnam at midnight under a surreal glowing crimson red sky, traditional tiled roofs and warm golden street lanterns wrapped in low mountain fog, surrounding dark pine ridges

shots.dialogue: Chỉ vài giây sau, một vệt sáng chói lòa xé toạc màn đêm rồi lao thẳng xuống khu rừng phía Bắc.
shots.image_prompt: dramatic wide panoramic shot of a blinding crimson-white meteor streak tearing diagonally across the dark red-tinted night sky and plunging toward a deep misty pine forest ridge beyond the mountain town, volumetric light trail and distant shockwave glow

shots.dialogue: Khang nhìn xem! Chiếc la bàn cổ tự nhiên xoay loạn xạ rồi phát sáng!
shots.image_prompt: medium close-up of Linh Chi wearing her olive-beige field jacket and red hairpin standing next to Minh Khang on a misty cobblestone alley, holding up an antique brass compass glowing with bright amber-crimson runes that cast warm light onto both of their shocked faces

shots.dialogue: Thứ vừa rơi xuống không phải thiên thạch đâu. Đi thôi, trước khi quá muộn!
shots.image_prompt: dynamic medium action shot of Minh Khang turning sharply toward a misty forest path at the edge of town, dark navy trench coat swirling, pointing urgently toward a towering vertical crimson energy glow rising from the distant northern woods, Linh Chi beside him ready to run
shots.motion_prompt: dynamic handheld push-in camera, Minh Khang's coat billowing in wind, glowing red embers drifting through the dark mist, urgent expressive gesture

shots.dialogue: Và khi hai người bước vào màn sương đỏ, cánh cổng bị phong ấn suốt nghìn năm bắt đầu thức tỉnh.
shots.image_prompt: epic wide rear-view silhouette shot of Minh Khang and Linh Chi standing side by side at the entrance of a mist-shrouded ancient northern forest, looking up at a massive weathered stone torii-like ruin archway cracked with glowing crimson runes and swirling red mist awakening inside the gate
